module_summary: Round-robin arbiter selecting one of N requesters; maintains token for fairness and busy state.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: N-bit request input vector driving priority encoding and any-request detection.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: N-bit grant output: one-hot selection assigned from cur_sel.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Handshake acknowledge: when asserted, clears busy_flag and updates token.

anchors.name: gnt_valid_o
anchors.why: Single-bit valid indicator: asserted when grant is valid (not idle).

anchors.name: cur_sel
anchors.why: N-bit register storing current grant selection; updated each cycle if not busy.

anchors.name: busy_flag
anchors.why: Busy flag indicating pending grant; controls state transitions and cur_sel updates.

anchors.name: tok
anchors.why: N-bit round-robin token; rotated upon accept to maintain fairness.

anchors.name: any_r
anchors.why: Indicates any request present; drives busy_flag state transitions.

groups.name: Arbitration State
groups.description: Current selection and round-robin token registers maintaining arbiter state.

groups.name: Request/Grant Interface
groups.description: Handshake protocol: requests in, grant and valid out, accept handshake in.

groups.name: Control Logic
groups.description: Busy flag and any-request detection controlling state updates and grant validity.
